facts.claim: Chinese defaults to a 50-point report while English defaults to 25.
The Chinese grading prompt now defines 20/15/10/5 maxima, score anchors, and a no-renaming rule.
Report summary is built by a pure function and used by both clipboard copy and system share.
MainActivity implements the essay_trainer/share MethodChannel using ACTION_SEND.
The Chinese live check returned 41/50 with exactly the four anchored dimensions.
CI runs formatting, analyzer, and 60 tests on Ubuntu, and builds an arm64 debug APK on non-PR runs.
Secret/signing files, .tooling, .jspace, build and dist artifacts are ignored; docs screenshots and pubspec.lock remain tracked.
Local arm64 debug build succeeded with a writable Android home and official Flutter storage; the checkout's Tencent mirror lacks debug Maven artifacts.
